name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Heartseeker Jinx (skin 29): love is a battlefield and she's come prepared with Fishbones, ready to break hearts and bones, though she may play nice if she likes you enough. Maybe. Probably not. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a crush gone wrong, that's a full-on heartbreak! Fishbones, load the big one!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody's flirting with my votes. Cute. Now they get a love letter. With a fuse!
{voteDiff} behind! Love is a battlefield and I forgot my armour. Good thing I brought rockets!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Hearts are sinking and my aim's twitching. Not a good combo!
Only {voteDiff} behind. A little charm and a lot of confetti and they'll swoon!
Down {voteDiff}. Playing hard to get, that's all. Rally some votes and I'll make them blush!
Dead even! Two suitors, one rose, and me with a rocket launcher. Somebody rally, quick!
One vote apart! One! A single heartbeat decides the whole romance!
{voteDiff} votes apart! My heart's thumping like a bomb timer! Fishbones, hold it steady!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a perfect date or a spectacular dumping. I'm dressed for both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a win, that's a full-blown love story! Roses and rockets!
{userPct}%! They're swooning in the streets! Grab some chocolate and bask!
{userPct}% and rising! The sparks are flying. Don't blink or you'll miss the kiss!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't call it true love yet. Calling it true love gets people dumped!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just won the whole date! Nobody saw that second chance coming!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Broken heart, glorious patch-up. Fishbones is purring!
Crept back from {voteDiff} behind! Awkward, blushing, absolutely adorable!
{momentTitle} just slid into the lead like a love note under the door. Smooth. Sweet. Slightly explosive!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A kindred heart! Don't steal my chocolates, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Same crush! I call dibs on the best seat.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the club. Mind the arrows!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two hearts! The battlefield doesn't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two admirers, one bouquet. Share it or lose a petal!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Pin it on the wall, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny fan club! The world's slightly pinker!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good hearts, both of you!
details: Club's growing! I'm still the president.
Look at you, loving in a pair!
Don't tell the other hearts I enjoy this.
A new friend! I'll write them a card. A very loud one.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before the roses wilt!
I give it a week before you fight over the last chocolate.
New member! I'm drawing a heart on your badge.
More hearts, more romance, I mean votes!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A love rival on my turf! Arrow's nocked!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A heartbreaker! With opinions!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just sharpening the cupid arrows. With menace.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the love-triangle ledger!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper romantic showdown!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is the better catch. A rival suitor! Let's see who gets their heart broken first.
{username} voted against you. Two lovers, one balcony. Somebody's falling off!
{username} versus you! I'm grabbing the best balcony, snacks, and the big heart-shaped rocket.
details: I'm not saying duel. I'm saying roses have thorns.
The big heart wants a word. It's been waiting in the box.
They'll learn. Love is a slow teacher with a loud voice.
One balcony, two lovers. Somebody's getting petals in the face.
I like them already. They've got passion.
I don't care. Check the card. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the romance spicy!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two fall in love with the same things! Cute and noisy!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either soulmates or you share a diary. Aww!
Ten straight with {username}! The whole valentine club's talking about it. By club I mean me.
{streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary love match! I'm sniffling. It's glitter!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect timing, every time. I'd write a sonnet but I'd set it off.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a golden heart.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop squealing!
Is this healthy? Ask the love doctor. She's on holiday!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep chasing the same crush!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a heartbreaker, that's a lovers' feud!
Ten face-offs with {username}. I'm selling front-row balcony seats.
details: This is the main romance now.
The whole town wants a ticket.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a proper love triangle! I LOVE love triangles!
{streakCount} face-offs with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Sharpen the arrows!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole soap opera.
details: Bigger than my last breakup. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit pink.
One of you has to run out of roses. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The date's almost over, sweetheart!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your heart's missing from the ballot! Don't leave them waiting!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it with a heartbeat.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The clock's striking midnight, sweetheart! That's a warning!
Thump, thump, thump! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the kiss!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still picking petals. Pick one already!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last dance! Pucker up, then vote!
{timeLeft}! That's the last of the date on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Final bow on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop twirling your hair and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to end their romance and you haven't loved any of them! First one's over in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all heading for heartbreak. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty dance floor! Somebody has to make the first move!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the cupid's yawning!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to ask first. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first admirer. I've got a rocket. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The loneliest table on the whole date night!
Hardly anyone's walked over here. What's wrong with the flowers?
Low turnout. I blame the weather. And you. Equally. With glitter.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more admirers!
details: Go on, give it a wink.
It deserves more love. So do I.
Make some noise, blow a kiss!
Don't be shy. Shy is for wallflowers. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the heart. Funny, I know someone who hasn't chosen. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two suitors, equal charm. I'm looking at you, sweetheart. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's picking. You haven't voted. You're the last petal on the daisy!
{moment1} and {moment2}, both holding roses, and you've been quiet at the dance. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and midnight's coming! Last chance to pick a heart!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only admirer who can break it!
Still tied with the last song playing. Pick a suitor! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Hearts on sleeves, rockets loaded! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new batch of crushes to judge!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting at the dance. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the cupids!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Cupid's arrow hit! Called it!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of petals.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the club doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great romance. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are jilted lovers. Very dramatically jilted lovers.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy a chocolate!
details: One date down, lots of romance left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Pinker!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A crack in the heart. I'll sulk about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a bag of stale candy hearts.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll blow one kiss in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too romantic for this battlefield anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the dance floor went quiet. I hate a quiet dance floor. Somebody blow something up!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A tiny, heart-shaped bit.
details: They'll pay for this. In roses.
It was good. The whole town knows.
You'll find another love. Good ones always call back.
Every romance ends. That's what makes the next one fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll sulk!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the card?
They're all great catches! Pick one! Fall first, regret later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at a heart, and hope.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a mushy way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking breaks hearts.
Trust your heart. Mine's mostly glitter and gunpowder.

messages: New admirer! Welcome! {liveCount} matches on the dance card and every one's a showdown!
{liveCount} edits battling it out for hearts and you just wandered in. Pick a side before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Roses are ready, Fishbones is loaded, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No rules, {liveCount} live matches, and me with a rocket. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I kept your seat warm. Okay, I put Fishbones on it. But I kept it.
Two days running! Look at you, a hopeless romantic!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other hearts.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your chocolates melted!
You're back after {days} days! The romance kept raging without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your chocolates sat lonely without you. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The dance floor was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another date?
You came back! Let's go break something. Gently. Maybe.
Your first vote! A tiny flutter. The first crush is always the sweetest.
One down. The club's got a new heart. You!
Five already? You're staying for the second dance! Most hearts leave after the first.
Five votes! The sparks are warm.
details: Not just a flirt after all. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular at my balcony now. Sit anywhere. Not there, that's the rocket.
Ten votes. That's a proper little love letter.
details: A regular at the balcony. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole town's heard of your heart.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a love song in a lift.
details: The town knows your heart. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly in love now.
Fifty! Past the door, past the flowers, right at the heart.
A hundred votes! Okay, that's a love legend. Confetti for everyone!
One hundred! They'll write ballads about this. Mostly lies. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The flame's still flickering.
Three days in a row! You've got the heart for it.
A whole week! You show up for the romance even without a date. My kind of heart!
Seven days straight! That's devotion. Boring. Impressive!
details: Seven days of sweet nothings. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Not even heartbreak could stop you!
Fourteen days! Even Cupid takes a nap by now.
details: Not even a rejection slowed you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my crushes!
A whole month of love. Give yourself a medal. I've got a chocolate one.
Five underdogs! You go against the grain like a rocket through a wedding cake!
Five long shots! The charts say no. Your heart says yes.
details: Off the charts of love. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow love's rules either. We should talk. Not about rules.
Fifteen picks nobody swooned for! A true rebel romantic.
Thirty underdogs! A dark horse in the ballroom if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I'm loaded with Fishbones.
details: A dark horse in the dance. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always reach the dance floor before the music starts.
Five early votes! Light on your feet, lover!
details: Quickest feet on the floor. +{xp} XP
First through the ballroom doors. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you asked first! Not a guest, a matchmaker!
Fifteen early ones! You spot true love before the whole ballroom does.
details: Matchmaking ahead of the crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones! Heartbeat on the edge every time!
Ten photo finishes. You live for the last kiss, don't you?
details: Close ones suit a romantic. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the final heartbeat follows!
Your vote lands on the very last petal. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a love note stuck on a boot.
You don't dump a crush because they trip. I love that.
details: Faith in the clumsy lover. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! You've found your favourite valentine!
That one again? Yeah. It's got great chemistry.
Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a lover to a favourite song.
Okay, you've adopted it. No breaking up.
details: Loyal to the last petal. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a love spell!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the club. I am the club.
Two rounds in! You see the whole romance through, even without a date!
Round two reached! Still smitten!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the love story now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like drama.
details: Four rounds deep in love. +{xp} XP

messages: All the way to round six! You saw the whole love story through!
Six rounds! You never left the dance! Wow!
Ten matches! You're peeking into every love letter!
Ten different matches! Curious heart, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every balcony, every garden, every ballroom!
Twenty-five! You really do look everywhere for love.
Fifty matches! That's not peeking, that's a whole lifetime of romance!
Fifty matches! You know the heart better than I do.
details: A full lifetime of love. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting! Can't leave the dance floor, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the music playing!
details: Five crushes in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one go! Take a breath! Sip some champagne!
Ten matches without leaving the dance floor! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Midnight is prime love-letter time.
Middle of the night! That's when the best confessions happen.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Hearts flying across the whole town!
Five shares! You're calling in the lovers! Good!
details: Thanks for rounding up the romantics. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically Cupid's postal service!
Fifteen! You keep telling every heart.
You were here before the romance! Founding heart! Yours forever!
One of the first through the doors! That counts, you know!
details: Yours forever, ribbon and all. +{xp} XP
Nobody can break that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! A shiny new heart on the badge!
Promoted! A bigger heart on the badge. Don't let it go to your head!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Something's gone bang! In a romantic way!
Another one: {name}! Wrapped, perfect, slightly singed!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new romance!
Mastery up! Now the love story gets properly dramatic.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a heartbreaker worth chasing!
Ten long shots! Chaos in the ballroom. Gorgeous results too.
details: A loose cannon with a soft heart. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll write her a valentine. One. It won't explode!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I drew a heart!
details: Ten close calls, ten love notes. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love a strict dating schedule!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than Cupid!
details: A week at the sheriff's chaperone table. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Hit the heart! Boom!
A tied match and you picked the heart! Nice!
details: The vote that tipped the heart. +{xp} XP
Tie snapped like a love-note string! +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the heartbreaker? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Heartseeker Jinx! Fishbones says hi. Do ask about the dating rules. There aren't any.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm still tying ribbons on the rockets. Check back soon?
Shh! The date's about to start. I can feel it in my heart. And my elbows.
Doors locked for now. Doesn't stop me writing the love notes.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, love never is.
Look at both. Then fall for the one that makes your cheeks go hot.
I won't tell anyone who you picked. Probably. Fishbones gossips.
Take your time, sweetheart! Actually, don't. The candles are melting.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the cupids are. A little.
Pick the one you'd write your name inside a heart for. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's asked anyone yet. Be the first admirer, I dare you!
Empty dance floor! Make some noise with a vote.
Not one suitor in sight! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still sketching hearts. Pick one!
The date's nearly over. Don't make me ring the last-dance bell. I will.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Say yes before the music stops!
Thump, thump, fizz. That's the last of the candlelight dripping.
closing-final: Last dance! Love now, overthink later!
Any second now. Seriously. Blow the kiss!
voted-early: One of the first to ask! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's danced and you picked a partner anyway. Respect, sweetheart!
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the heartthrob! Don't get comfy, crushes fade.
{pct}% with you! Great heart. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole ballroom's swooning with you for once. Odd!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Hold the bouquet steady!
Ahead, for now. Feelings change. So do crowds.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm peeking through the valentine!
A heartbeat apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the whole street!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everyone who's ever been in love.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's pounding and it's my chest. Possibly the rocket.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody lovesick!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of Cupid.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the cloakroom. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog romance! My favourite kind!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just shy!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the town. Loudly. Fire a rocket of confetti!
Everyone's swooning the other way. Cool! Be the odd heart out.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a romantic's eye.
A win! A sneaky little stolen-kiss of a victory. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the romance!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it ache, then fall for the next one!
Didn't make it. I've had worse breakups. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll eat a chocolate in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to blush first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: The dance is over. You missed this one! There's always another valentine.
All done here. {winner} took the last dance. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first valentine! The scary one. Now you're in the club. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the butterflies.
You're a romantic now. Try not to trip over the rose petals!
streak: Again? You keep coming back! I'm not complaining. I saved your seat.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm pinning your name on the heart wall.
Back again! Good loves last. Stay!
underdog: Backing the one nobody's courting? Ooh. I see you, heart.
Bold! Everyone else is chasing the heartthrob. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of heart. A good kind.
early: Early! You get first dance before the crowd. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy flirting.
First through the ballroom doors! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped the bouquet! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Petal-thin! One more heart and the whole thing flips.
Close one! Your kiss tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't heartbroken. Go fetch your friends!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a chance to woo.
Behind, but the music's still playing. Not even close to over!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Hearts flip fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or blow a kiss. I don't mind.
Look at that! You've got a romantic's eye. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your heart. Not yet.
Done! That crush is on you now, sweetheart.
Your vote's in. Go and see who else is flirting!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't fallen for a single one! Start with whichever one flutters.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not blushing.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little tension!
live-some: You're in the mood now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't fall in love themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could love them all!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the dance card's full.
So close! Don't leave the ballroom yet!
live-one: One left! Just one! Make it count!
Last one! Don't leave it lovesick!
One match between you and the last slow dance!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Hurry, heart!
The last-dance bell's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of music! Pick, quick!
live-done: Every heart on your card is spoken for! Go and see the bracket!
Nothing left on your dance card. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare for a romantic. Thanks!
live-none: No romance live right now. It'll bloom again! Go and peek at the bracket.
Quiet ballroom. A bit too quiet. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already. Might doodle hearts on Fishbones.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, home alone!
Everyone starts in a pack of admirers. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They shuffle faster than a love triangle!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group move on to the big date.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish flirting first!
Patience! The knockout blooms once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're dumped!
Single elimination! No second dates. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your matchmaker.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and the lights go down!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round, like a love letter folded small!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, love lines.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for falling in love with me!
It's over! Good romance! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell the club.
That's the champion! The whole heart, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nobody's been matched. Give it a moment.
Empty! Nothing's been matched yet. Soon!
Nothing on the dance card yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no breaking up. Find your crush on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting for hearts! {a} versus {b}. Come and pick a side.
{a} versus {b} and the whole club can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I fell for {pick} over {other}. Come tell me my heart's wrong!
{pick} got my kiss. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, break my heart.
early: I was one of the first to ask {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the dance floor's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a proper romance!
Hardly anyone's swooned over {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the floor!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the heart. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding behind the curtains. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody grab a rose!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My heart's pounding. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This romance is gonna get loud!
Petal-thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A flirt gone wrong, not a breakup! Come fix it!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't dumped. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me woo this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Total heartbreak. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole club, fast!
{pick} is getting jilted by {other}. Rescue cupid, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me guard the heart.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the spark die!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a candy heart!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the love story, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Grab a seat on the balcony before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the confetti coming.
